title: Configure Auto PR Triage ownership for PyTorch
body:
Stack from [ghstack](https://github.com/ezyang/ghstack) (oldest at bottom):
* #195933
* #195778
* __->__ #195777

Seed the repository-specific layer separately from the reusable implementation. The codepath rules are an exact copy of the root CODEOWNERS file, while the semantic metadata and team rosters match the ciforge pilot configuration.

Test Plan:

```bash
cmp CODEOWNERS .github/auto-pr-triage/codepath_owners.txt
jq -e 'keys == ["autograd", "flex_attention", "nn"]' .github/auto-pr-triage/extra_ownership_metadata.json .github/auto-pr-triage/team_members.json
git diff --cached --check
```

`lintrunner -a` was attempted, but the local `uv` rejected the host `~/.config/uv/uv.toml` before linting.

Authored with an AI assistant.
